courses.synopsis: Pre- slaughter handling of different farm animals. Slaughtering methods, dressing and post-mortem changes in meat. Meat quality. Methods of meat preservation. Processing of abattoir by-products. Meat inspection and grading. Meat processing – bacon, sausages etc. Meat hygiene. Milk products and processing e. g. ice – cream, butter, yoghurt, cheese etc. Egg quality, handling, storage and grading. Animal by-products, blood, hooves faeces and their uses. Hides and skin processing- flaying, curing, tanning. Hides and skin utilization.
